method: Actual combatTick at20ms steps. Four ordinary foes drawn from the real regional monster pool and immediately replaced after a kill: normal99 uses91-99, reborn150 uses141-150. No spawn-wait ceiling, random bosses, progression or loot growth. Primary acceptance: max/min of three-seed mean kills/min across all40 job/pet pairs, separately with no cards and a declared per-job legal-slot card heuristic. Not exhaustive optimal builds or a guarantee for every custom allocation/rotation/intermediate level. Current-tier uncommon gear; uncommon pets at99 and ascended legendary pets at150, deterministic IV3, all normally available paid skills; reborn main and permanent buff10/10 paid from Job51-70. Legal allocated points, primary/secondary gear attributes; wizard INT/DEX gear and20 points from VIT to AGI. Named resonance opener (shield or effective heal) precedes main where required; other priorities fixed, not auto-optimized during combat. Previous-tier maximum-affix legendary calibration is separate:60/80/100% of gear affixes, legal allocated attributes and selected card effects; all111+ pets are ascended legendary. Intrinsic level, Job and pet base growth remain unchanged, so these are controlled input-coverage tests rather than a literal percentage of final combat power or an entry gate. Cards use a declared balanced legal-slot heuristic, not an exhaustive optimum. All40 pairs, three seeds,120seconds at111/121/131/141;101 unchanged diagnostic uses one seed. Potions included. Fixed elite-HP stress results are unfiltered diagnostics and not averaged into acceptance. Tanking/healing is never scored as kills. Potion stocks are deliberately large: survival does not imply free or potionless farming.
